The Apartment.name: The Apartment
The Apartment.vignette: A small, third-floor unit in a crumbling urban complex. The emergency power flickers weakly, casting long, dancing shadows across walls covered with peeling wallpaper and a single framed photo of a sunnier time.
The Apartment.appearanceDescription: A cramped studio apartment with a single window overlooking the street, a fire escape bolted to the side, and a heavy front door with three deadbolts. The kitchenette is to the left, cluttered with half-packed emergency supplies. The air smells of dust, stale coffee, and cold fear.
The Apartment.backstoryDescription: This apartment has been your sanctuary for three years. You know every creak in the floorboards, every draft from the poorly sealed window. Tonight, its walls feel paper-thin against the chaos outside.

The Alleyway.name: The Alleyway
The Alleyway.vignette: A narrow, garbage-choked corridor between two brick buildings. The streetlight above flickers and sparks, illuminating piles of trash bags and a single, overturned dumpster that leaks something dark and viscous.
The Alleyway.appearanceDescription: The walls are tagged with faded graffiti, and the pavement is slick with rain and something else you'd rather not identify. A fire escape ladder hangs down from above, swaying gently. Broken glass crunches underfoot near a shattered basement window that gapes like a dark mouth.
The Alleyway.backstoryDescription: A shortcut you've taken during the day, now a gauntlet of shadows and noises. Local legend said a homeless man disappeared here last winter. No one investigated.

The Hallway.name: The Hallway
The Hallway.vignette: The narrow corridor of your apartment building's third floor, lined with faded floral wallpaper and a single buzzing fluorescent light that throws sickly green light across the scene.
The Hallway.appearanceDescription: A claustrophobic hall with four apartment doors—yours, your neighbor's, and two others that have been ominously silent all night. The air is heavy with the smell of smoke and copper. The floor is strewn with a torn welcome mat and what looks like a child's shoe.
The Hallway.backstoryDescription: You've exchanged pleasantries with your neighbors here for years. Mr. Chen in 3B always watered your plants when you were away. Mrs. Vasquez in 3D would bake cookies for the holidays. Now their doors are shut and silent.

The Stairwell.name: The Stairwell
The Stairwell.vignette: A concrete shaft of echoing darkness, reeking of sweat, copper, and something else—something sweet and wrong. Each landing holds a door to a different floor, and each door has its own story of what waits beyond.
The Stairwell.appearanceDescription: Graffitied concrete walls, flickering emergency lights casting strobing shadows. The stairs are littered with debris—a shattered phone, a single sneaker, dark splatters that could be paint or could be something else. The air is cold and still, except for the occasional distant groan echoing up from below.
The Stairwell.backstoryDescription: The backbone of the apartment building, usually taken for granted. Now it's a vertical labyrinth where sound travels strangely and shadows move independently of their owners. Floor by floor, the infection climbed. Floor by floor, people fell.

The Rooftop.name: The Rooftop
The Rooftop.vignette: A tar-paper expanse under a starless sky. The city sprawls out below in a patchwork of darkness punctuated by scattered fires. The wind here is sharp and cold, carrying smoke, sirens, and distant screams.
The Rooftop.appearanceDescription: Flat roof covered in gravel and patches of tar. An HVAC unit hums quietly in one corner. A clothesline still holds a few forgotten shirts, dancing in the wind. The edge is a low wall—beyond it, a four-story drop to the street, where shapes shuffle in the dark.
The Rooftop.backstoryDescription: The highest accessible point of the building. From here, you can see the whole neighborhood burning. The rooftop door is heavy and metal, and if you could barricade it... maybe this could be a sanctuary. For now, it's just a place to catch your breath and witness the scale of the nightmare.

Alex Chen.name: Alex Chen
Alex Chen.vignette: Your neighbor from apartment 3B, a friendly graphic designer in their late twenties who always had a kind word and a pot of coffee ready. You've never seen the terror in their eyes that you hear in their voice tonight.
Alex Chen.appearanceDescription: Mid-twenties, average height, with messy dark hair and glasses. They're dressed in rumpled pajamas and a bathrobe, clutching a phone with a cracked screen. A deep scratch runs down their left forearm, still oozing blood.
Alex Chen.backstoryDescription: Alex moved in two years ago and quickly became the friendly face of the building. They work from home as a freelance designer and often keep odd hours—which is why they were awake when everything went wrong. They have a cat named Pixel who is currently missing.

Player.name: Player
Player.vignette: You. The one staring into the dark, heart hammering against your ribs, trying to remember if you locked the window.
Player.appearanceDescription: You—in your rumpled clothes, clutching your phone like a lifeline, shadows clinging to your face. You look exactly as you did ten minutes ago, except the world has ended.
Player.backstoryDescription: Your story is unwritten. You're an ordinary person in extraordinary circumstances, and every decision from this moment forward will carve the path of your survival—or your demise.

The Infected.name: The Infected
The Infected.vignette: They were people once. Now they move with a jerky, unnatural grace, their limbs bending at wrong angles, their eyes glazed over with a milky film. They don't speak—they only make sounds: wet clicks, guttural growls, and the occasional shriek that sounds almost human.
The Infected.appearanceDescription: Humanoid figures with pale, clammy skin marred by dark veins. Their eyes are white and pupil-less. They wear tattered clothes—pajamas, work uniforms, a bathrobe—remnants of their former lives. Their mouths hang open, drooling a viscous fluid, and their fingers end in blackened nails like claws.
The Infected.backstoryDescription: No one knows where they came from. The emergency broadcast mentioned a "contamination event" before cutting out. They seem to be drawn to sound and movement, and their bite carries something that turns you in hours—or minutes. They don't tire, they don't feel pain, and they *hunt*.

Maya Ortiz.name: Maya Ortiz
Maya Ortiz.vignette: A sharp-eyed woman in her early thirties, dressed in a leather jacket and carrying a crowbar. She moves with the practiced silence of someone who has already survived the worst of whatever this is. There's a hard-won knowledge in her eyes, and a deep, bone-tired weariness.
Maya Ortiz.appearanceDescription: Hispanic woman, athletic build, with dark hair pulled back in a tight ponytail. She wears a scuffed leather jacket over a hoodie, jeans, and combat boots. A crowbar hangs from her belt, and she carries a small backpack. A fresh bandage wraps around her left hand.
Maya Ortiz.backstoryDescription: Maya was a paramedic before the world ended. She was on shift when the first cases came in—people biting and tearing at each other in the ER waiting room. She barely made it out. She's been moving through the city ever since, looking for other survivors and trying to understand what's happening.

Lily.name: Lily
Lily.vignette: A small girl of about eight years old, clutching a worn teddy bear and a photograph of her grandmother. Her eyes are red from crying, but there's a spark of resilience in them that reminds you that children are stronger than we give them credit for.
Lily.appearanceDescription: A young girl with dark hair in two messy pigtails. She wears pajamas with cartoon cats on them, and a small pink backpack. Her face is smudged with dirt and tears. She's small, fragile, and gripping a teddy bear like it's the only thing keeping her tethered to reality.
Lily.backstoryDescription: Lily Vasquez was visiting her grandmother for the weekend when the outbreak began. She saw her grandmother change into one of the infected and barely escaped. She's been hiding in the apartment ever since, too scared to move, waiting for someone to find her.
